'''Rendezvous Point 4''' was an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] base on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Edan II/Legends|Edan II]]. After the destruction of [[Edan Base]], Rendezvous Point 4 became the fallback location for Alliance forces. Under the command of [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Pertarn]], Alliance forces from the base assaulted and destroyed the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Havoc (Imperial-class)|''Havoc'']].
